name: 马超
design: MA CHAO, 马超. A youthful adult warrior with a lean angular face, slightly narrow amber-brown eyes, upward decisive eyebrows, clear cheekbone planes and a proud restrained smile; clean shaven. His face MUST differ from the round soft face of reference3. White-silver fitted battle helmet with a short ivory crest and two small side ornaments, not a ponytail-only crown. Silver-white lamellar armour over ivory cloth, muted teal jade bindings, restrained warm-gold fittings and a burgundy waist tassel. Slender athletic chibi body, upright poised stance, compact ivory shoulder cape. Exactly one complete long silver spear held near upright beside the body at screen-right, with the spear point and butt both fully visible. No horse. No extra sword. Main silhouette is narrow helmeted lancer, not Zhao Yun copied and recolored.

name: 黄忠
design: HUANG ZHONG, 黄忠. An elderly veteran with a broad weathered kind but resolute face, heavy white eyebrows, clear crow-feet and cheek creases, a full flowing WHITE beard and white moustache. He must read as an old man even in chibi form, not a young face with a pasted beard. Sturdy barrel-chested short body. Antique bronze and warm-gold armour, ivory sleeves, muted russet-brown outer cloth with restrained jade fasteners. A low bronze general helmet showing white hair at temples. Hold one complete recurved wooden bow vertically at screen-left in a relaxed down-ready pose, bowstring and both tips fully visible; a compact quiver with several arrow tips behind shoulder, wholly inside canvas. Other hand rests near belt. Bow is character equipment, not a troop-type label. Do not copy Guan Yu black beard, green turban or guandao.

name: 魏延
design: WEI YAN, 魏延. A powerful mature warrior, broad square jaw, deep-set brown eyes, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm ruddy skin, a close square black beard and short moustache, stern confident closed-mouth expression. Broad shoulders and compact heavy muscular chibi build. Distinct angular low bronze helmet with a flat ridge, dark reddish-brown and copper armour with muted jade cords and ivory cloth, small dark red cape kept close to body. Exactly one broad single-edged dao sabre, held nearly upright down at his side; both complete blade and hilt visible. Other hand on waist. No long beard, green turban or polearm from reference3. No exaggerated evil caricature, no fangs; this is a dignified general with a visibly different face.

name: 庞统
design: PANG TONG, 庞统. A middle-aged rustic strategist with a notably WIDE rounded face, broad nose, uneven thick eyebrows, small clever eyes, slightly lopsided amused smile, short scruffy moustache and sparse short chin beard. Short stocky chibi body with relaxed shoulders. Modest low folded olive-brown scholar cloth cap, never the tall ornate hat of reference3. Warm ochre-brown and muted olive robes, ivory inner sleeves, a few jade beads and fine warm-gold edging, restrained and practical. Right hand holds a complete simple knotted wooden walking staff with a small gourd tied near its grip; left hand holds a closed bamboo scroll. No feather fan. No black flowing prince hair, no handsome Zhuge Liang face. The broad face, stocky build, simple cap and rustic staff distinguish him at avatar scale. These are original artistic design choices, not a claim of historical appearance.

name: 徐庶
design: XU SHU, 徐庶. A thoughtful middle-aged scholar with a long lean oval face, gently lowered eyelids, straight serious brows, narrow moustache and short neat jaw stubble rather than a pointed long goatee. Shoulder-length straight black hair neatly tucked under a LOW squared dark cloth scholar cap and simple jade band. Tall/slim within the same chibi proportions, composed upright stance. Slate-indigo outer scholar robe, ivory inner robe, muted jade trim and restrained warm-gold fasteners, plain cloth waist sash. Both hands hold a closed bamboo manuscript at the waist; one short straight sword remains fully SHEATHED at his left belt, complete scabbard and hilt visible. No feather fan, no tall Taoist hat, no Zhuge Liang copied face or extravagant hanging ornaments. Clear difference from Pang Tong broad face and rustic stocky build.
